Front: Name the five layers of the cornea, outside in.
Back: Epithelium, Bowman membrane, stroma, Descemet membrane, endothelium.

Front: Where is aqueous humor produced and where does it drain?
Back: Ciliary processes; drains through the trabecular meshwork into the canal of Schlemm.

Front: Which retinal cells form the optic nerve?
What is the fovea, and why is acuity highest there?
Back: A cone-only pit at the macula; it has the highest photoreceptor density and minimal overlying tissue.
Endolymph (high K⁺) fills the membranous labyrinth; perilymph (high Na⁺) fills the bony labyrinth.
Protection and support; the cornea also refracts
